confirmed_missing_contract: Native syscall 33 reports task pid for workers, syscall 34 reports task parent; neither is a stable native group query.
existing_authority: Scheduler::native_group_owner_index matches the full address-space identity and retains the owner until borrowers reap.

proposed_abi.name: NativeProcessIdentity
proposed_abi.input: rdi selector: 0 retained group pid; 1 retained group ppid; 2 calling task pid
proposed_abi.output: rax native result/error sentinel; no user pointers
proposed_abi.invalid: EINVAL for selector outside 0..2 or Linux caller; EIO if no current task or retained owner

security_review.authority: Observes only the calling group. Accepts no target pid or generation and grants no authority.
security_review.generation: Existing complete address-space identity is the membership key; never match solely by pid.
security_review.lifetime: All lookup and read occur under SCHEDULER. No cached reference, allocation, mutation, callbacks or new locks.
security_review.termination: No changes to termination/reaping/retirement; _Exit/_exit and pthread_exit retain existing paths.
security_review.parent: Returns retained group record ppid; existing reparenting policy remains authoritative.
security_review.ABI: Separate syscall preserves historical raw syscall33 thread-identity callers; C pid_t overflow must fail EOVERFLOW.
